name: product-finder
description: Developer convenience scripts. The apps themselves live in backend/ and frontend/.

scripts.postinstall: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait db && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:e2e --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
